leastWorthwhile.text: Making cell fluid was the least engaging moment: the result showed dissolved particles but added little explanation beyond the expected combination.

surprise.text: The inset showing copied strips passing through nuclear pores helped me understand how stored instructions can be used outside the nucleus.
